description.zh: 为模型注入最新、按版本区分的库与框架文档和代码示例。无需鉴权即可试用；在请求头填 CONTEXT7_API_KEY 可提升额度。
description.en: Feed up-to-date, version-specific library and framework docs and code examples into prompts. Works without auth; add a CONTEXT7_API_KEY header for higher limits.

description.zh: 用自然语言查询任意公开 GitHub 仓库的代码结构与文档（Devin Wiki）。免费，无需鉴权。
description.en: Ask questions about any public GitHub repository's code and docs (Devin Wiki). Free and no authentication required.

description.zh: 面向 AI 的网页搜索与内容抓取。匿名可用但有限速；填 API Key（Authorization: Bearer 或 x-api-key 请求头）可提升额度。
description.en: AI-oriented web search and content fetching. Usable anonymously with rate limits; add an API key (Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key header) for higher limits.

description.zh: 读写仓库、Issue、PR、Actions 等。用 GitHub PAT 作为 Bearer 令牌即可接入。
description.en: Read and write repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions and more. Works with a GitHub PAT sent as a bearer token.

description.zh: 检索 Cloudflare 官方文档，供 AI 参考最新的 API 与配置用法。无需鉴权。
description.en: Look up Cloudflare's official documentation so AI can reference current APIs and configuration. No authentication required.

description.zh: 读取并管理你的 Cloudflare 账户配置（Workers、DNS、安全等）。需通过 OAuth 授权。
description.en: Read and manage your Cloudflare account configuration (Workers, DNS, security and more). Requires OAuth authorization.

description.zh: 用自然语言管理 Neon Postgres：建库、开分支、跑 SQL。支持 OAuth 或 Neon API Key（Authorization: Bearer）。
description.en: Manage Neon Postgres with natural language: projects, branches and SQL. Supports OAuth or a Neon API key via Authorization: Bearer.

description.zh: 让 AI 检索并读写你的 Notion 工作区内容。官方托管服务，需通过 OAuth 授权。
description.en: Let AI search, read and edit your Notion workspace. Hosted by Notion and requires OAuth authorization.

description.zh: 查询与管理 Linear 的 Issue、项目和评论。支持 OAuth，也可直接用 Linear API Key 作为 Bearer 令牌。
description.en: Find, create and update Linear issues, projects and comments. Supports OAuth, or a Linear API key as a bearer token.

description.zh: 接入 Jira、Confluence、Bitbucket 等 Atlassian 云产品，支持 OAuth 2.1 或 API Token。
description.en: Connect Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket and other Atlassian Cloud products. Supports OAuth 2.1 or an API token.

description.zh: 读写 Asana 的任务、项目与工作区数据。需先在 Asana 控制台注册 OAuth 应用，其 V2 服务不支持动态客户端注册。
description.en: Read and write Asana tasks, projects and workspace data. Requires an OAuth app registered in the Asana console; the V2 server does not support dynamic client registration.

description.zh: 检索错误、分析性能、排查线上问题。官方托管服务，需通过 OAuth 授权。
description.en: Search errors, analyze performance and triage production issues. Hosted by Sentry and requires OAuth authorization.

description.zh: 让 AI 读取 Figma 设计上下文，并可写回画布。官方托管服务，需通过 OAuth 授权。
description.en: Give AI access to Figma design context and let it write back to the canvas. Hosted by Figma and requires OAuth authorization.

description.zh: 让 AI 调用 Stripe API 并检索 Stripe 文档。优先 OAuth；不支持 OAuth 的客户端可用受限 API Key 作为 Bearer 令牌。
description.en: Let AI call the Stripe API and search Stripe docs. OAuth is preferred; clients without OAuth can use a restricted API key as a bearer token.

description.zh: 用自然语言处理 PayPal 发票、订单等业务。官方托管服务，需通过 OAuth 授权。
description.en: Handle PayPal invoices, orders and other business tasks with natural language. Hosted by PayPal and requires OAuth authorization.
